description: Land Acquisition - Makubura North, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Amendment to the Notices published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1904/33 of 04.03.2015 by Naula D/S Division and No. 1301/18 of 15.08.2003 by Baddegama D/S Division.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices under Section 7 of the Act describing specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of the lands, ownership information, extents, and compensation procedures. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
